newsitem.title: UK: Express revamps daily, Sunday titles.
newsitem.headline: Express revamps daily, Sunday titles.

text.p: Express Newspapers, a unit of United News & Media, said it will reorganise its Daily and Sunday Express titles, involving 85 job cuts.
It added that Richard Addis will head a single editorial team for both newspapers. Addis is currently editor of the Daily Express. Sue Douglas has resigned as editor of the Sunday Express.
